Release date: 04/09/2026
The FAO Food Price Index averaged 133.3 points in August 2026, up 2.5 points (1.9 percent) from July. Compared to last year it was 3.2 points (2.5 percent) higher.
The FAO Cereal Price Index averaged 116.3 points in August, up 2.5 points (2.2 percent) from July.
The FAO Vegetable Oil Price Index averaged 196.9 points in August, up 1.2 points (0.6 percent) from July.
The FAO Dairy Price Index averaged 119.2 points in August, up 2.7 points (2.3 percent) from July.
The FAO Meat Price Index averaged 127.9 points in August, up 1.3 points (1.0 percent) from July.
The FAO Sugar Price Index averaged 106.4 points in August, up 11.3 points (11.9 percent) from July.
